g.text: UC-13 - Detect Application and Evaluate Rules (planned FST-027/FST-028)
[enabled rule matches and detection is not debounced]
[no policy / no match / duplicate log tick]
Do not collect a target or enforce a rule.
Capability failure produces diagnostics, not a fabricated detection.
Debounce suppresses repeated logs, not protection of a new instance.
Enforcement never runs for an ignored/no-match observation.
